description: This PHP source file defines a class SugarWidgetSubPanelRemoveButtonMeetings that extends SugarWidgetField. It provides functionality to generate a remove button link for a subpanel related to Meetings within the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM environment, allowing users to remove meeting records from a related list.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelRemoveButtonMeetings
classes.description: A widget class for rendering a remove button in the Meetings subpanel, enabling deletion of relationship records between Meetings and other entities.

methods.name: displayHeaderCell
methods.description: Returns a non-breaking space to be displayed as the header cell in the subpanel column.

methods.name: displayList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML anchor tag with JavaScript to remove a Meeting record from the subpanel, handling context and confirmation dialogs.
